messages:
leo (DevEx): FYI ran into weird behavior in the nextjs-rag-starter: after an auth refresh the SDK retry sends duplicate prompts to the model, we get duplicated paragraphs in the UI.

anika (SDK): Hmm, duplicate tokens? Can you paste the client init + call and a minimal transcript?

leo (DevEx): Client: ```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-sdk'
const c = Redwood.createClient({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, retry:{maxRetries:2, backoffMs:200}})
await c.generate({model:'redwood/llama-rag', prompt})
```
Transcript: "AI: Summary A\nAI: Summary A" (exact dup)

nina (QA): We also saw duplication when network returned 401 then 200 on replay. Looks like the model got the prompt twice.

anika (SDK): That suggests the retry wrapper resubmitted the same request body after a partial response was already delivered. Streaming vs non-streaming nuance? Which endpoint used?

leo (DevEx): Using streaming in the sample (response streaming -> SSE in edge route). The UI attaches eventSource to /api/stream. If the original got 401 mid-stream, SDK retried and the new stream started but the frontend didn't drop the partial buffer, so UI concatenated both.

tom (Eng): Two things to fix: 1) SDK should not automatically re-emit a streaming request if any data already emitted; 2) the sample should demonstrate idempotency tokens or dedupe on the client. We should add guidance in the starter.

anika (SDK): Agree. Immediate plan: add a guard in retryer that if a response stream has emitted bytes, treat auth errors as fatal (no retry). For non-streaming we can keep current behavior. Also add opt-in idempotencyKey support for generate calls.

docs-bot: Added todo: docs#1589 - "Streaming retry guidance + idempotency examples".

nina (QA): I'll write a unit + e2e that mocks 401 after N bytes and asserts no duplicate final output.

leo (DevEx): For now, quick workaround in the sample: set retry.maxRetries=0 for streaming routes and include a small dedupe on the UI side (drop identical consecutive events). Patch I tested: ```diff
- const c = Redwood.createClient({retry:{maxRetries:2}})
+ const c = Redwood.createClient({retry:{maxRetries:0}})
```
Works in staging.

anika (SDK): I'll open PR to: a) change retryer; b) add idempotencyKey param; c) publish canary and update example package.json. Will post PR link.

tom (Eng): Also we should add telemetry flag 'retry_streaming_blocked' so we can spot users hitting this.

leo (DevEx): Thanks all — moving to close once PR is merged and README updated. :)
